statements.text: Can you suggest a stretching routine for my lower back? I'm an IT support analyst at a logistics company here in Pune and I sit about nine hours a day, so by evening my back is completely stiff. Nothing fancy please, I only have about ten minutes before dinner.

Quick question about my scooter. It's a Honda Activa and the ride to the office is around forty minutes each way through Baner traffic, so mileage matters to me. Is 45 km per litre normal for it, or should I be getting more? Also, what's a decent engine oil to use?

I'm trying to budget groceries better. I share a flat in Baner with two flatmates, so we split the basics like rice, oil and cleaning stuff, and I buy my own vegetables. Can you suggest a way to track shared expenses without making it awkward? We tried a notebook but it keeps getting lost.

Planning meals for the week. I've been vegetarian my whole life, so dal, paneer and soy chunks are my main protein sources, and I'd like some variety without becoming a full-time cook. Can you suggest a high-protein menu? About 90 grams a day is my target.

I finally joined a gym near my office and I go Monday, Wednesday and Friday straight after work. Can you build me a beginner full-body routine for those three days? Also, how long should I rest between sets? I always forget what I read.

Python question while I work through a free course on weekday evenings: what's the practical difference between a list and a tuple? I keep mixing them up and the course just moved on to dictionaries, which feels like a big jump. Could you give me a twenty-minute exercise to lock the basics in?

Good news, I got promoted last week and I'm now the team lead of our support desk, six people in total. It also means more meetings and a lot less time fixing laptops myself. Can you suggest how to run a fifteen-minute daily standup that doesn't drag? I've never led meetings before.

My lower back is acting up again after a long week. The forty-minute scooter ride each way isn't helping, and I still do the stretches you gave me every evening. Do you think I should see a physio, or can I keep managing with stretches alone?

Big news, I moved out of the shared flat last weekend and now live in a one-bedroom in Wakad on my own. It's quiet but I'm still figuring out utilities. Can you give me a checklist for setting up a first solo apartment, like internet, a gas cylinder and so on?

Since the Wakad move the scooter ride had grown to over an hour, so three weeks ago I sold the Activa to my cousin and started taking the company shuttle from Hinjewadi. I can read on the way now. Any audiobook recommendations for a fifty-minute ride, preferably non-fiction?

Can you explain how to read a nutrition label properly? I'm comparing two protein bars where one says 20 g per serving and the other says 14 g per 40 g bar, and I can't tell which is really better value. A quick method I can reuse in the shop would be great.

I've had to change my gym days. Weekday sessions aren't realistic anymore with how my evenings go, and I only manage Saturday and Sunday mornings, an hour each. Can you restructure my routine into two longer full-body sessions? I don't want to lose my squat progress.

I'm off to a colleague's wedding in Jaipur next weekend and I'm a little worried about the food, since being vegetarian I usually end up with just rotis and sabzi at big events. Any tips for politely asking the caterers? Also, what should I wear in October heat?

I left the logistics company at the end of October and started at a fintech startup this week as a support engineering manager, so no more company shuttle for me. The pay is better but I already miss my old team. Could you help me draft a 30-60-90 day plan for the new role?

The new office turns out to be a ten-minute walk from my Wakad flat, which still feels like a luxury after all those shuttle rides. I'm trying to use the saved time well. Could you suggest a short morning routine that fits in forty minutes, with some movement and no phone?

Can you recommend a beginner-friendly book on managing engineers? I keep reading blogs but I'd like something structured that I can finish in a couple of weeks, ideally under three hundred pages. I'm especially curious about giving feedback without sounding harsh.

I got engaged! Meera and I are planning to get married in April, and I'm trying to sort out a budget for it. Can you suggest a simple method for splitting costs between the two families and ourselves, so nobody feels awkward about money?

I skipped my Sunday gym session because of a festival visit to my parents. I'm still sticking to the weekend-only gym schedule, so I don't want to lose two sessions in a row. Can you suggest a quick bodyweight routine for twenty-five minutes at home?

My doctor says my LDL is high, so I've cut out cheese and most paneer, and I now eat eggs and a little fish twice a week, which is a huge shift after a lifetime of being vegetarian. Can you suggest easy ways to cook fish without the whole flat smelling for days?

Do you have a high-protein breakfast that takes under ten minutes? I'm bored of the same boiled eggs and I don't want to spend longer than ten minutes before leaving. Something with oats or lentils would be fine too, as long as it's filling.

We're trying to sort out our savings before the wedding. I put 20 percent of my salary into a monthly SIP in an index fund and I'm wondering whether to raise it now that my pay has gone up. Is there a rule of thumb for choosing the percentage, or does it just depend on goals?

We got married on the 19th and last weekend we moved into a bigger two-bedroom flat in Kharadi, since the Wakad place was too small for two. The catch is it's twenty-five minutes from the office, so I take a cab now instead of walking. Any ideas for arranging the small second bedroom as a study?

Since the wedding costs came in under budget I've raised my SIP from 20 to 30 percent of my salary, set up last week. Meera thinks it's too aggressive. Can you help me stress-test that number against a six-month emergency fund and our rent?

I also started playing badminton on Thursday evenings with a few colleagues, since Meera works night shifts at the hospital on those days and I'd otherwise be alone at home. Can you give me some shoulder warm-ups so I don't pull anything? My first game was a disaster.

Can you help me write a clear patient handout on managing mild hypertension? I'm a nurse at a private clinic in Victoria Island and my supervisor asked me to make something simple with big text for older patients. About 150 words, plain language, and a line or two about salt in meals like ogbono soup would be perfect.

Work has been exhausting lately, I do twelve-hour night shifts, usually four a week, and my sleep is a mess. Can you suggest a routine for sleeping properly in the daytime? Lagos noise and the neighbours' generators don't help, and my room gets really hot by ten in the morning.

My cat Biscuit has started scratching the sofa and my mother is not amused. She's two years old and I adopted her from a neighbour's litter. What can I do to redirect the scratching without anything cruel like declawing, which I would never do?

I still live with my mother in the family flat in Yaba and the noise is wearing me down, but rents in Lagos are crazy right now. Can you help me work out a realistic budget for moving out, assuming a one-bedroom costs around six hundred thousand naira a year?

I take the BRT bus to Victoria Island every day and it's about an hour each way if the traffic is bad. Are there any good nursing podcasts or audio courses I could listen to on the bus? I'd love something that counts towards continuing education.

My doctor put me on iron tablets, one every morning, for anaemia and I keep forgetting them. Any tips for remembering? And should I take them with orange juice? I've heard that tea and iron don't mix well, which is a problem because I love my evening tea.

My Infinix phone's screen cracked a month ago and the touch has become glitchy, which is a nightmare when I'm entering patient vitals into the clinic app. Is it worth repairing or should I upgrade? I can spend maybe 150,000 naira at most.

Can you explain the difference between type 1 and type 2 diabetes in simple terms I can use with patients? I always get tangled when they ask about insulin and diet. A short script of about five sentences would help, ideally with an everyday comparison.

I made a dress for my cousin's engagement from ankara fabric, my first time doing a proper lining. I've been sewing since I was fifteen and it's my favourite way to switch off after a hard week. Any tips for getting neat hems on curved edges?

Good news, I've been moved to day shifts starting this month, seven to seven, so I can finally sleep at night like a normal person. How should I reset my body clock after two years of nights? I'd like to be properly awake by my first morning on the ward.

Biscuit knocked over my mother's favourite plant again and now the cat is officially my responsibility, which is fair. Do scratching posts really need to be tall, or are cheap short ones fine? She's still young and full of energy at two and a half.

I replaced the cracked Infinix last week with a Samsung Galaxy A15 and the camera is a big upgrade for photographing fabric. Can you explain how to move my WhatsApp chats and work app logins safely? I'm nervous about losing patient reminders.

My follow-up bloods show my haemoglobin is back to normal, so the doctor told me to stop the iron tablets. I'm a bit scared I'll slip again though. Is there a food plan to keep my levels up using ugu, beans and liver without eating the same thing every day?

Spent the weekend at my aunt's place in Ibadan, and coming back to Yaba and my mother's cooking felt like relief, though I'm still counting the months until I can afford my own place. Do you have a savings plan template for a flat deposit?

What are some good warm-up stretches for nurses who are on their feet all day? My calves are killing me by evening and I'd like something I can do in the locker room in five minutes. Are compression socks actually worth buying, or is that marketing?

I signed a lease! Last week I moved into a one-bedroom flat in Surulere, my first place on my own. The landlord says no pets, which I only read properly after signing, though my sister Ngozi says she could take Biscuit if he won't budge. Any advice on how to raise it politely?

The landlord wouldn't budge, so Biscuit now lives with my sister Ngozi in Lekki. I visit on Sundays and it breaks my heart a little. Is it normal for a cat to act distant and sulky for a few days after I visit her?

I've been asked to give a short talk on infection control to the new interns. Can you help me structure ten minutes covering hand hygiene, PPE and sharps disposal? I want it practical, not just slides full of rules nobody remembers.

I got the offer! I start this month at the Lagos University Teaching Hospital as a staff nurse, so no more long BRT rides to Victoria Island, it's a short bus ride from my flat now. I'm nervous about the bigger wards though. How should I prepare for my first month?

My doctor at the new hospital started me on vitamin D, one capsule a week, after routine bloods showed it was low. Does it matter whether I take it with food? Also, can I take it right after my evening tea, or should I wait a while?

I picked up crocheting during the long Harmattan evenings and I'm making a baby blanket for a colleague, while I still sew whenever I get a free weekend. Can you explain how to read a basic crochet pattern? The abbreviations like sc and dc are throwing me.

My Samsung's battery barely survives a shift now, probably because I use it for charting and the drug-dose calculator all day. Any settings to stretch it? I don't want to carry a power bank onto the ward.

I'm putting aside about eighty thousand naira each month for the UK nursing registration exams, hoping to work abroad one day. Can you break down what costs I should expect, like exam fees, visa and flights? I'd like a rough total so I can set a target.

Sadly the hospital has rotated me onto night duty, three nights a week, so the day-shift life lasted much less than I hoped. Could you help me build a sleep plan again? I'm dreading the first block, and the new flat has thin curtains.

After three months at the teaching hospital my feet are in a sorry state. Can you recommend what kind of shoes nurses wear for twelve-hour shifts? The wards here are huge, and my phone says I walk at least six kilometres each shift.

I've decided against moving abroad, the exam fees plus the visa are just too much and I'd rather stay near my mum and my sister. I've stopped the monthly transfers and I'd like to put that money towards a proper sewing machine instead. Which features matter most for a beginner?

Could you help me make a clearer checklist for visual inspection of small brass fittings? I'm a quality inspector at a metal parts factory in Higashiosaka and our current sheet is two pages of tiny text. Ideally I'd like one page, with photos of pass and fail examples in mind.

We live in a company-subsidised apartment block in Hirakata, third floor, no elevator, and my knees complain every time I carry the shopping up. Do you have tips for reducing the strain on my knees on stairs? I'm 48, so I suppose it's age creeping in.

The drive to the factory takes about twenty-five minutes in my Daihatsu Tanto, a kei car, and fuel prices lately are painful. What are the best ways to improve mileage without buying anything? I mostly do short trips and the engine rarely warms up fully.

My doctor put me on amlodipine for high blood pressure last year and I take one every morning with breakfast. Does it matter if I skip a day when I'm travelling? Also, are there any foods I should avoid, like grapefruit?

My son Haruto is in his second year at a university in Kyoto and still commutes from our place, but he's glued to his phone at night and his grades are slipping. Any advice on how to talk to a twenty-year-old without it turning into a fight? My wife Yoko says I'm too blunt.

On Sundays I usually go fishing for horse mackerel off the pier in Osaka Bay, leaving around five in the morning. Can you suggest an easy way to cook small fish when I bring home too many? Yoko is tired of frying everything.

Yoko works part-time at a supermarket three days a week and she's thinking of asking for more hours. How should she raise it with her manager without sounding like she's complaining about the current schedule? She hates confrontation, so a script would help.

My iPhone 8 only lasts half a day on a charge now, and the photos I take look terrible in low light. Is it worth replacing the battery, or is the phone too old to bother with? I'd rather not spend more than ten thousand yen on it.

Can you explain the 50/30/20 budgeting rule and whether it works when overtime pay changes a lot from month to month? I'd like something I can set up in a spreadsheet in under an hour. No complicated apps please, I get lost in menus.

Big change at work: I've been moved from the inspection line to the production planning office, so I'm at a desk most of the day instead of on my feet. Can you suggest how to learn basic scheduling concepts quickly? I only know the shop floor side of things.

Haruto's end-of-term results came back decent, and Yoko and I are relieved. He still stays up late with his phone, but at least he's studying at the kitchen table most evenings now. How do I encourage him without hovering over his shoulder?

I switched blood pressure medicine to losartan because the amlodipine made my ankles swell, and the doctor said that's quite common. I take it once a day after breakfast. Is there anything about losartan and salty foods I should know, since Japanese cooking uses so much soy sauce?

I traded in the Tanto for a used Toyota Aqua hybrid last Saturday, and the mileage is already unbelievable. The dealer said the hybrid battery warranty is five years. Any maintenance tips for a hybrid, since I've only ever driven simple kei cars?

Sunday fishing off the pier is still the best part of my week, and lately the sea bream have been biting, so Yoko cooked one for the neighbours. Any ideas for preparing sea bream beyond grilling? Also, is there a good way to freeze whole fish without ruining the texture?

What's the difference between a regular savings account and a fixed-term deposit at Japanese banks right now? I'd like to understand the interest rates and the penalties for early withdrawal. Please keep it simple, I get lost in banking terminology.

Haruto moved into a share house in Kyoto with three university friends last week, so it's suddenly just Yoko and me at home with his empty room. He says the daily commute was wearing him out, and the house is quieter than I expected. Any ideas for what to do with the spare room, maybe a small reading corner?

I finally bought a new iPhone 15 after the old one died completely on a train, and I'm lost with all the gestures. Can you walk me through transferring my photos and LINE chats from the old backup? I'd like to keep my chat history intact.

We moved out of the company apartment last weekend into the small secondhand house we bought in Neyagawa, and I'm already enjoying having no stairs to climb with the shopping. Can you suggest a sensible order for unpacking? Yoko wants the kitchen done first.

The Aqua's display shows 28 km per litre on my trip to the office, which my coworkers don't believe. Is that realistic, or is the display optimistic? I'd like to check it against real fill-ups for a month and compare the numbers.

Yoko took a full-time job as a receptionist at a dental clinic this month, so our evenings have changed a lot. Can you suggest a fair way to split the housework now that she's out of the house all day? I want to do my share without being told.

My lower back gave out at the pier and the doctor told me to stop standing for hours on piers. So I've given up the Sunday fishing and bought a road bike instead, riding along the Yodo river. Can you suggest a beginner cycling plan that won't aggravate my back?

Could you recommend a few simple stretching exercises for someone who sits for long hours? Being at a desk all day in the planning office, my shoulders and neck are very tight these days and I'm trying not to rely on painkillers. Ten minutes would be perfect.

My doctor added a statin on top of the losartan after my latest cholesterol numbers, so now I take both with breakfast. Is it fine to take them at the same time, or should I split them? Also, any foods that interact with statins besides grapefruit?

Yoko and I are planning a week in Hokkaido in October, flying from Kansai, and I'd like help with a rough itinerary. We love hot springs and seafood, but we're not keen on very long drives. Could you suggest an order for Sapporo, Otaru and Furano?

I rode forty kilometres along the Yodo river on Sunday and my back held up fine, which makes me happy. Do you think it's a good moment to add some hills, or should I keep building distance first? I don't want to overdo it after the back trouble.

Could you suggest some games I can play over a video call with my granddaughter Lucia? She's four and lives in Madrid with my son Javier, so I only see her in person every couple of months. She gets bored after ten minutes, so I need quick, simple ideas, nothing that needs props I don't have.

My right knee has osteoarthritis, the rheumatologist says, and stairs are the worst part. Are there exercises I can do at home that won't make it worse? I'm 62 and I really don't want to give up my daily walk by the river if I can help it.

I live alone in my flat in Triana, third floor without a lift, since my husband Paco passed away three years ago. Can you give me ideas for making the place feel less quiet in the evenings? I keep the radio on, but it isn't the same as company.

My little dog Canela, a twelve-year-old mutt, has started refusing her dry food. Should I mix in some cooked chicken, or is that a bad idea? She's the reason I get out of the house twice a day, so I worry about her more than I'd admit.

I'm planning my weekly lunches and I always have a slice of jamon serrano with my bread and tomato, every single day, a habit from my mother's kitchen. Can you suggest some new Andalusian recipes using chickpeas and spinach? I'd like variety without losing that daily ham ritual.

I go to a watercolour class on Tuesday afternoons at the cultural centre and I'm struggling with skies, they always come out muddy. Any advice on wet-on-wet technique? The teacher says I overwork the paper, but I find it hard to stop fiddling.

My old Samsung tablet has become painfully slow, and my video calls with Lucia freeze every few minutes. Is there anything I can do to speed it up, like clearing the cache? I'd rather not spend money on a new one if I can avoid it.

I'm trying to work out my monthly budget now that I'm retired from teaching. My pension is 1,450 euros a month and the electricity bill in summer is shocking. Can you show me a simple way to split it into fixed costs, food and a little fun money?

How can I tell whether an email supposedly from my bank is a scam? I got one yesterday saying my account would be blocked unless I clicked a link, and I nearly did. Is there a quick checklist I can print and stick next to the telephone?

My friend Pilar and I are going to Galicia for ten days next month, by train, and I'd love help with a packing list. I'll be walking a lot in A Coruna and Santiago, so comfortable shoes are the priority. Also, any must-eat dishes beyond pulpo?

Back from Galicia and it was wonderful, the pulpo in Santiago lived up to the hype and Pilar and I walked far more than I expected. I took hundreds of photos and I have no idea how to sort them. Can you suggest a simple way to organise them into albums, preferably something I can do without a computer?

I had my right knee replaced two weeks ago and I'm home now with a walker. The physio says I should do my exercises three times a day, and I keep forgetting the second set. Could you make me a simple daily schedule? Neighbours are bringing food, which is lovely but I feel useless.

Canela hasn't been walked properly since my surgery, so the neighbour's boy takes her around the block. She's thirteen now and she seems to be putting on weight. Is there an indoor game I can play with her while I can't walk far?

My son Javier gave me an iPad for my birthday and I'm a little scared of it. The video calls with Lucia are so smooth compared to my old tablet, but I keep closing apps by accident. Can you explain how to keep the camera on and the volume up without pressing the wrong things?

Does Spanish public healthcare cover physiotherapy after a knee replacement, and for how many sessions? My surgeon's office gave me a leaflet, but it's full of abbreviations I don't understand. Can you explain what I should ask for at my health centre?

Wonderful news: Javier got a transfer, and he, his wife and Lucia moved to Sevilla last weekend, only twenty minutes from my flat. I'm over the moon! What are some good activities for a four-year-old and a grandmother who still can't walk very far?

The watercolour class has moved to Thursday afternoons from this term, which suits me better because Tuesdays were always busy with physio. We're starting on portraits and I'm terrified of faces. Any tips for getting proportions right as a beginner?

My cardiologist says my blood pressure is too high and told me to give up cured ham and cut the salt, which feels like losing a friend. I've stopped the daily jamon now. Can you suggest tasty low-salt sandwich fillings that still feel Andalusian?

Climbing to the third floor with no lift is still hard even with the new knee, and last week I paused on every landing with the shopping. I'm not complaining, just tired of it. Any tricks for carrying groceries up stairs safely?

I adopted a kitten named Nube from the shelter, a tiny grey thing, and Canela is not impressed at all. How do I introduce them gently? Canela has been hiding under the table and the kitten keeps pouncing on her tail.

I sold the Triana flat and moved in with my sister Carmen, into her ground-floor flat in Nervion, because the stairs were too much and we get along better than I expected. Any advice on dividing space and chores without driving each other mad?

Lucia and her parents come for lunch every Sunday now, which makes the week feel shorter. She turns five in June, so I'd like to plan a small birthday with a few cousins and some painting. Can you suggest a simple schedule for a two-hour party at home?

Do you have a recipe for gazpacho that uses less salt but still tastes good? Carmen says mine is bland, and my cardiologist wants me under five grams of salt a day. I'd also love a few ideas for flavouring with herbs and lemon instead.

Good news from the pension office: my monthly payment went up to 1,530 euros after the yearly revaluation, and I can finally contribute to the household bills here without feeling guilty. Can you help me update my budget with the new figure?

Canela passed away peacefully last week at thirteen, in her basket with me beside her. I knew it was coming but the house feels very empty. Can you suggest a gentle way to mark her memory, and how to help Nube, who keeps looking for her?

Lucia has a baby brother! Mateo was born on Monday and Javier sent photos at dawn. I'd like to knit something small for him, and I haven't knitted since the nineties. Can you suggest a simple pattern and a wool that's gentle on newborn skin?

Can you help me write a clearer README for an internal payments service? I'm a backend developer at a fintech in Malmo, mostly Go and a bit of Rust, and our docs are a mess of outdated wiki pages. I'd like a structure that new joiners can follow in their first week.

We're in the office Monday to Wednesday and work from home on Thursdays and Fridays, which I like, but my focus on the office days is terrible because of the open plan. Any strategies for deep work in a noisy room? I already own noise-cancelling headphones.

I cycle to the office, about fifteen minutes along the canal, all year round, and last winter's ice almost put me down, so I'm thinking about studded tyres for next winter. Are they worth it in a flat city like Malmo, or is that overkill? My current tyres are slick commuter ones.

Elin and I live in a two-room apartment in Mollevangen and the kitchen has barely any counter space. Can you suggest some clever storage ideas that don't involve drilling, since our landlord is strict? We cook a lot, so the clutter really bothers us.

I've been vegan since 2022 and I'm hosting a dinner for six friends who are not, so I want something impressive but simple. Can you suggest a three-course menu that doesn't feel like a compromise? One of them keeps asking where I get my protein.

I boulder on Tuesday evenings and Saturday mornings at the climbing gym near the harbour, and I've been stuck at the same V4 grade for months. Any ideas for breaking a plateau? Someone told me to focus on footwork rather than pulling harder.

My personal MacBook Air with the M1 chip is still going strong, but the storage is nearly full with photos from climbing trips. What's the safest way to offload them, an external SSD or cloud storage? I'd rather not pay a subscription forever.

Can you explain how Go channels differ from mutexes, and when you'd pick one over the other? I keep writing code with too many goroutines that block each other. A small example comparing both approaches would help me explain it to a junior colleague.

Our company has cut the office days to just Wednesdays, starting this week, so I'll be at home four days out of five. I'm excited but a bit worried about isolation. Can you suggest a good structure for a home workday, with breaks and a hard stop at five?

My bike chain keeps skipping after all the rain lately. Do I need a new chain and cassette, or can a proper clean and lube fix it? It's a steel-frame commuter, nothing fancy, and I do the fifteen-minute ride to the office every Wednesday.

Big change: I resigned from the fintech and joined a climate-data startup as a senior engineer, fully remote, so I haven't touched the bike commute or the office since I started. The team is scattered across Europe. Can you suggest how to build trust with colleagues I've only met over video?

At a colleague's barbecue everyone assumed vegan meant salad, and I ended up eating grilled corn and hummus again. Can you give me a few polite lines for asking hosts about options before I arrive? It's getting tiring after three years as a vegan.

I strained a finger pulley at the gym and my physio says no bouldering for at least six months. I'm gutted. I've started swimming three mornings a week instead and want a basic plan. Which strokes will be gentlest on a healing finger?

How often should vegans get their B12 checked, and are weekly supplements as effective as daily ones? I read conflicting advice online and doctor's appointments are hard to get. Please keep it short, I'll discuss it with my GP anyway.

I treated myself to a new MacBook Pro with the M4 chip after the old Air's battery began swelling, and the speed difference is silly. Can you help me set up Time Machine and a sensible folder structure from scratch? I'd like to keep my work and personal files separate.

I also bought a second-hand iPad Pro for sketching and note-taking, so now I use it alongside the laptop for meetings. Can you recommend an app for handwritten notes that syncs to the laptop? Searchable handwriting would be a bonus.

Elin and I bought a terraced house in Lund and we moved in over the weekend, so we've left Mollevangen after four years. Can you suggest a sensible order for sorting out utilities and change of address in Sweden? I never remember which authority needs notifying first.

We adopted a retired racing greyhound named Gunnar from a rescue and he is tall, gentle and terrified of stairs. Can you suggest how to teach him to climb them? He freezes at the bottom and refuses treats completely.

I've gone back to eating dairy and eggs, so I'm basically vegetarian now, because my iron levels were low and the supplements weren't enough. Can you suggest a week of high-iron meals that include some cheese and eggs? I don't want to lose my vegan habits entirely.

My sourdough starter has gone sluggish after the move and smells like nail polish remover. Is it dead, or just hungry? I'd like to rescue it rather than start over, and I keep it on the counter with a loose lid.

My swimming is finally improving, I did 1,500 metres without stopping this morning and nothing hurt in the finger. Should I add drills or just keep building distance? I swim three mornings a week and don't want to burn out.

Sad news, the climate startup ran out of money and shut down in March, so I'm freelancing as a backend consultant now. Can you help me work out a day rate that covers taxes, pension and unpaid holidays? I'm in Sweden and registered a sole proprietorship last week.

Gunnar finally climbed the stairs by himself last night and I nearly cried. He still sleeps most of the day, which is apparently normal for greyhounds. How much exercise does a retired racer actually need? I'm walking him twice a day.

Elin and I split up in April, and I've moved into a one-bedroom flat in Limhamn with Gunnar, while she kept the house in Lund. It's a lot to take in. Can you help me draw up a simple list of practical things to sort out, like the mortgage and shared accounts?

Can you help me understand pointers in C? I'm in the first year of computer science at a university in Casablanca and our professor went through them in twenty minutes yesterday, so everyone looked lost. A simple analogy would help, and maybe a tiny example I can run.

I live with my parents in the Maarif district and my little brother keeps taking over the only decent desk in the flat. Do you have tips for creating a quiet study corner in a crowded apartment? I can't really afford a separate desk right now.

I take the tram to campus every morning and it takes about thirty-five minutes, so I try to use the time to revise flashcards. Can you suggest an app or method for spaced repetition that works offline? The signal drops between stops.

My dad gives me an allowance of 1,500 dirhams a month for transport, lunch and books, and by the third week I'm usually broke. Can you suggest a realistic way to budget it without feeling like I can never do anything fun?

I tutor two kids in maths on Saturdays for 80 dirhams an hour and one of them is very distracted. How can I keep a nine-year-old focused for an hour without sweets as a bribe? I only started a few weeks ago and I don't want to lose them.

My Dell Inspiron has 8 GB of RAM and it freezes whenever I open the IDE and a browser together. Is there any way to make it usable for coding without buying a new one? A new laptop would eat my whole savings for the year.

I play football with a women's team in the neighbourhood every Sunday, and we have a friendly match coming up against a team from Rabat. Can you give me a good pre-match warm-up routine? I always feel stiff in the first twenty minutes.

I drink about three coffees a day, mostly during revision, and lately my heart races at night. Is that normal for a student, or am I overdoing it? Please don't just say drink less, tell me how to taper without getting headaches.

What's recursion in simple terms, and why do my functions keep crashing with a stack overflow? I'm trying to write a factorial function and I think I'm missing something about the base case. Could you walk through an example step by step?

I stopped tutoring after the family moved to Rabat, and now I do freelance Arabic-French translation for a small agency, paid per page. Can you suggest how to price my work fairly? They offered 40 dirhams a page and I'm not sure if that's low.

My third coffee of the day again, while finishing an assignment due tonight, and I know I should cut back. I really like the ritual of it, especially with a little cardamom. Can you suggest a switch to something less caffeinated that still feels like a treat?

I bought a refurbished ThinkPad with 16 GB of RAM from a shop in Derb Ghallef, and it's so much faster that coding feels fun again. Can you help me set up a clean Python environment and a decent editor? I'd also like automatic backups of my important files.

I got accepted into the data science track for my second year, so I've left the general computer science stream. The first lectures are heavy on statistics and I'm nervous. Can you recommend a gentle way to relearn probability from scratch?
